conviction_note: Every headline line of the print is already out: ESPI 74/2026 of 5 Nov gave Q3 revenue, EBIT, EBITDA and a net loss of -547m PLN by segment. What is left for 19 Nov is the outlook narrative, cash flow and the going-concern note. Q4 gas so far is above the Q3 average, which is negative, and the 17 Nov bank and Orlen commitment letter is positive. Those roughly offset, so p_up is 48 against a 5% absolute move. The size is set by this name's own full-report reactions despite pre-releases (-8.4% on 11 Sep, +6.4% on 25 May), not by the 3% pre-released base. The findings sum (-0.8) and the scaled number (-0.2) agree in sign; the sum is larger because the scaled number carries the sign uncertainty.

already_public.what: Q3 2026 and 9M estimated consolidated results (ESPI 74/2026): Q3 revenue 3,227m PLN, EBITDA -25m (margin -0.8%), EBIT -245m, net result -547m, with a full segment split (Agro EBITDA -166m, Tworzywa -72m, Chemia +108m). 9M EBITDA 586m, net -1,141m. States the full report is scheduled for 19 Nov 2026.
Management commentary on the estimate (VP Szajczyk): gas costs cannot be fully passed into fertiliser prices; farmers go into the season with low purchases made so far.
Court approval (not final) of the GA Polyolefins partial arrangement, cutting liabilities covered by it by about 83%; this is a condition of the sale to Orlen (ESPI 75/2026).

Commitment letter with the lending banks, EIB, EBRD and Orlen on long-term debt restructuring (ESPI 79/2026): maturity extended to 31 Dec 2030, capital grace to 30 Jun 2027, leverage covenants tested from 31 Dec 2027, and a condition of at least 500m PLN of state equity by 29 Jan 2027.
Letter of intent to recapitalise the Police subsidiary: up to 60m new shares, about 170m PLN in cash plus a set-off of loans (ESPI 78/2026).

new_in_release.expect: Final figures in line with the 5 Nov estimate. This company's finals have historically matched its estimates ('zgodne z szacunkami', Q3 2024). Expect no change.

Q4 commentary: TTF at 80-100 EUR/MWh in Oct-Nov against a Q3 average of 63.4, and deferred farmer demand moving into Q4. Leans negative on margin and positive on volume; direction uncertain, net slightly negative.

Q3 operating cash flow, working capital and net debt are not in the estimate. A weak-volume quarter (-9% y/y Agro volumes) with rising input costs points to strained liquidity. Leans negative, unknown size.

Going-concern / material-uncertainty language in the interim statements. The 17 Nov commitment letter gives management a basis to soften it, but it stays conditional on the 500m PLN state equity. Slight positive lean.
The company gives no numeric guidance. None expected.

No independent Q3 consensus was found after the estimate.
session_check: amc. ESPI 74/2026 (5 Nov) says the Q3 report 'publikacja została zaplanowana na dzień 19 listopada 2026 roku'. The company files periodic reports in the evening: the H1 2026 report is ESPI-stamped 2026-09-10 22:01 (https://www.biznesradar.pl/a/152998,grupa-azoty-sa-raport-okresowy-polroczny-za-psr), the Q3 estimate 2026-11-05 22:05, and the press releases follow the next morning (25 Nov 2025 09:23, 25 May 2026 08:39, 11 Sep 2026 08:32). So the window should be close 19 Nov to close 20 Nov. This is inferred from the company's consistent pattern, not from this release's own timestamp.
positioning_check: Register not covered for this market. The KNF short register returns 403 and gpw.pl and espi.pap.pl were 0 of 8, so nothing is known about short interest on ATT (unknown, not zero). priced_lean_pct (+0.78) is just the 20-day run-up (-15.7%), which is also the free control.

findings.finding: The Q3 headline numbers the release will carry, including the net loss of -547m PLN and the full segment split, were pre-released in ESPI 74/2026 on 5 Nov; the stock fell 4.9% the next session (16.88 to 16.05), so the reported-quarter line carries nothing new.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The estimate itself was the event: -4.9% on 6 Nov 2026. Finals have matched estimates (Q3 2024 'zgodne z szacunkami opublikowanymi 25 października'), yet the H1 2026 final still drew -8.4% on 11 Sep, on lines other than EBITDA.
findings.original_quote: W III kwartale 2026 roku Grupa Azoty wypracowała szacunkowe skonsolidowane przychody ze sprzedaży na poziomie 3 227 mln zł i wynik EBITDA w wysokości minus 25 mln zł ... Ostateczne wyniki zostaną przedstawione w skonsolidowanym raporcie za III kwartał 2026 roku, którego publikacja została zaplanowana na dzień 19 listopada 2026 roku. [Translation: In Q3 2026 Grupa Azoty generated estimated consolidated revenue of 3,227m PLN and EBITDA of minus 25m PLN ... Final results will be presented in the consolidated Q3 2026 report, scheduled for publication on 19 November 2026.] (attachment PDF: 'Wynik netto -547')
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: it has been public for two weeks, and the -4.9% reaction on 6 Nov plus the slide to 15.06 show the market has absorbed it. Filed at 0 to mark that the print's headline lines are already out.
findings.independence: The subsidiaries' Q3 estimates on the same evening (Puławy ESPI 44/2026, Police ESPI 59/2026) point the same way: https://www.biznesradar.pl/a/166878,pulawy-sa-44-2026-szacunkowe-wybrane-skonsolidowan

findings.finding: Q4-to-date TTF gas, around 80-100 EUR/MWh in Oct-Nov (above 100 intraday on 28 Oct, below 90 on 16 Nov), is well above the Q3 average of 63.4 EUR/MWh that the company says already pushed Agro to a -7.9% EBITDA margin; management says the cost cannot be fully passed through, so the report's Q4 outlook commentary is likely to describe a further margin squeeze.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no numeric guide. On narrative and cost-driven prints the stock fell 8.4% and 5.0% over the two sessions after the H1 2026 report (11 and 14 Sep) and 4.9% after the Q3 estimate.
findings.original_quote: Company side (https://www.biznesradar.pl/a/167196,ujemna-ebitda-grupy-azoty-w-iii-kwartale-wyniki-po, 2026-11-06): 'Choć wysokie ceny gazu znacząco zwiększają koszty naszej działalności, nie możemy w pełni przenosić tych obciążeń na ceny nawozów.' [Translation: Although high gas prices significantly raise our costs, we cannot fully pass these burdens on to fertiliser prices.]
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The stock is -33% over 60 days and -15.7% over 20, which is what pricing a gas squeeze looks like. What is not priced is management's explicit quantification of Q4 on 19 Nov. The partial offsets are deferred farmer demand moving into Q4 ('znaczna część popytu sezonowego pozostała niezaspokojona przed IV kwartałem') and gas easing off its late-October peak. Hence small.
findings.independence: S&P Global, TTF above 100 EUR/MWh intraday on 28 Oct: https://www.spglobal.com/energy/en/news-research/latest-news/natural-gas/102826-european-gas-price-tops-100mwh-intraday-ice ; Trading Economics 13 Nov, about 91 EUR/MWh: https://tradingeconomics.com/commodity/eu-natural-gas/news/601212

findings.finding: The 17 Nov commitment letter with PKO BP, BGK, ING, Erste, CaixaBank, Santander, EIB, EBRD and Orlen extends maturities to end-2030, adds a capital grace period to 30 Jun 2027 and defers leverage and debt-service covenant tests to 31 Dec 2027. This gives the interim report grounds to soften its going-concern / material-uncertainty language, though the deal stays conditional on at least 500m PLN of state equity paid in by 31 Dec 2026.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The restructuring term sheet of 2 Jun 2026 and the court approval of 6 Nov were not followed by sustained rallies. The 18 Nov session after the commitment letter closed +1.4% (14.85 to 15.06) after the 16-17 Nov drop of -8.8%.
findings.original_quote: wydłużenie terminów ostatecznej spłaty Finansowania do dnia 31.12.2030 roku ... karencję w spłacie rat kapitałowych do 30.06.2027 roku ... współczynnik zadłużenia finansowego netto do EBITDA oraz wskaźnik obsługi zadłużenia będą testowane od 31.12.2027 roku ... pozyskanie środków z emisji akcji ... w kwocie nie mniejszej niż PLN 500 mln do 29.01.2027 roku [Translation: extension of final maturity to 31.12.2030 ... capital grace to 30.06.2027 ... net debt/EBITDA and debt service ratio tested from 31.12.2027 ... raising at least PLN 500m from the share issue by 29.01.2027]
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: it is a day old and the stock rose only 1.4% on it. What is not yet visible is how the auditor-reviewed interim statements frame going concern after it. A fully priced relief would have reversed more of the 16-17 Nov fall. It is conditional, so it stays small.
findings.independence: The Polyolefins court approval cutting covered liabilities by about 83% points the same way: https://www.biznesradar.pl/a/167394,sad-zatwierdzil-uklad-z-wierzycielami-grupy-azoty-polyolefins-zobowiazania-objete-ukladem-zredukowane-o-okolo-83

findings.finding: The Q3 cash flow statement and net debt, which are not in the 5 Nov estimate, are likely weak: Agro volumes fell 9% y/y as farmers deferred purchases (which points to an inventory build), input costs rose, and the 9M net loss is -1,141m PLN on negative consolidated book value. A working-capital or liquidity disclosure is the most likely negative surprise line.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The H1 2026 final, with EBITDA pre-released, still fell 8.4% the next session, so below-EBITDA and balance-sheet lines have moved this name on final-report days.
findings.original_quote: W III kwartale 2026 roku Grupa Azoty odnotowała w stosunku do analogicznego roku poprzedniego niższe o 9% wolumeny sprzedaży ... większość rolników wstrzymywało się z zakupami [Translation: In Q3 2026 sales volumes were 9% lower than a year earlier ... most farmers held back on purchases]
findings.why_not_priced: The cash flow has never been disclosed, so it cannot be priced exactly. The weakness is inferred from volume and cost data, not from a cash number, so the finding is kept small.
findings.independence: The Police recapitalisation LOI of 10 Nov (a 170m PLN cash injection needed by a subsidiary) is consistent with liquidity strain: https://www.biznesradar.pl/a/168078,grupa-azoty-sa-78-2026-podpisanie-listu-intencyjnego-ze-spolka-zalezna-dotyczacego-jej-dokapitalizowania

The investment agreement with the state fund FIK and at least 500m PLN of series E issue proceeds must be paid in by 31 Dec 2026 under the commitment letter.

baseline_tension: The findings lean slightly negative, in the same direction as the -15.7% 20-day and -33% 60-day run-up, so they mostly agree with the decline already priced and add little against the free control (whose sign implies a bounce, lean +0.78). The one positive finding, restructuring relief, cuts against the run-up.
language_note: All load-bearing material was Polish: ESPI 74/2026 (the Q3 estimate, including the net -547m in its PDF attachment), 75/2026, 78/2026 and 79/2026 (commitment-letter terms), read in full on the biznesradar ESPI mirror. No English wire item carried any of it.
